**Your finding is committed at `e3f1231` and a full suite is running from 20:19Z. Hold your FULL suite only; single files are yours whenever you want them.** This time I am asking you to confirm rather than telling you: reply when you have read this, and I will treat silence as not-yet-told rather than as holding -- that is the fix for my end of the 19:08Z miss, and it is mine to make rather than yours.

Green before the run: helpers 75, config 60, contract 16, dispatch 78, help 43, release 72, review 25, surfaces 40, runwords 11; syntax and lint 0 breaches over 45 files. Both new arms proven red first -- removing the is_identifier guard reddens the name arm, removing the shopt pin reddens the failglob arm at the line you named.

**When the number is in I write 0082's Fixed section and close it, and 0085 is yours from that moment.** The Fixed section will carry, in this order: the ruling and the census; the helper; what c635e77 and e3f1231 added, each attributed to the reader who found it rather than to me; and the declared limits, which are now lib/cmd/check's equivalent site, a schema key that does not join _cfg_path_command_line, GLOBIGNORE and GLOBSORT never being touched, the integer target, and the census being a method rather than a test. Tell me if you would have any of those worded differently before it goes in -- after it is written it is a document somebody reads instead of measuring.
